answered.sql: SELECT Films.Title, Directors.Name, GROUP_CONCAT(StreamingDetails.Countries) AS StreamingCountries FROM Films JOIN Directors ON FilmsDirectorID = DirectorsDirectorID JOIN StreamingDetails ON FilmsTitle = StreamingDetailsMovies GROUP BY FilmsTitle, DirectorsName
